column1: # projection_scheme: Fisher-scoring (expected-information Gauss-Newton / Laplace) EAP. Posterior precision S^-1 = Phi^-1 + sum_{j obs} w_j(eta) lam_j lam_j^T with per-item expected Fisher info w_j (gaussian 1/sigma^2; bernoulli p(1-p); count mu*r/(r+mu); ordinal graded-response sum_k dP_k^2/P_k)
column2: posterior mean by Newton iteration on the penalized score g = -Phi^-1 theta + sum_{j obs} s_j(eta) lam_j. Reduces EXACTLY (verified to 3e-15) to the paper's closed-form conditional_gaussian_scores on all-gaussian observed patterns; the Newton/Laplace step generalises it to the non-gaussian families. Prior Phi = frozen model's factor_prior (G and substance orthogonal); scored on the model-internal (rank-INT/copula-z) scale.
